newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Berlusconi says coalition unlikely to fall.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Berlusconi says coalition unlikely to fall.

text.p: Opposition leader Silvio Berlusconi said on Thursday he thought it was highly unlikely that Italy's centre-left government would fall, despite tensions within the coalition.

"The forces of the left might argue, but they will never let this coalition fall," Berlusconi told a gathering of foreign reporters. "It would be very difficult for this government to fall," he added.
He told reporters that Prime Minister Romano Prodi's government was most at risk from centrist parties within the coalition.
"It could fall if moderates understand that they are distancing themselves from their principles and from their electorate," he said.
Earlier the coalition settled a potentially damaging dispute with parliamentary ally, the hard-left Communist Refoundation, over employment policy. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
